result.title: Hard Sample-Conditioned Decorrelated Attention for Robust Face Recognition
result.comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
result.summary: Multi-head attention in Vision Transformers (ViTs) allows independent attention patterns across heads, but without explicit regularization, heads may learn redundant patterns rather than complementary roles. Correlation-based penalties encourage head disentanglement, yet apply uniform regularization across all training samples. In face recognition (FR), hard samples whose embeddings lie close to competing identities are critical for optimization and generalization. Motivated by this, we propose ViT-HarDis, which conditions attention head disentanglement on sample difficulty: samples with high cosine similarity to negative class centers receive stronger head decorrelation, enforcing specialization where identity ambiguity is highest. Experiments show improvements over both the baseline and uniform disentanglement on most benchmarks. Our analysis shows that ViT-HarDis reduces the similarity of hard samples to competing class centers while decreasing inter-head attention similarity, and that applying disentanglement only to the final transformer layers outperforms regularizing the entire network. Trained on WebFace4M, ViT-HarDis achieves SOTA results among ViT-based methods on IJB-B, IJB-C, and TinyFace Rank-1, while achieving the best IJB-B and TinyFace results when trained on MS1MV3, improving FR without architectural modifications or additional inference cost. Code: https://github.com/TaharChettaoui/Hard-Sample-Conditioned-Attention-for-FR.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ViT-HarDis：依据样本与竞争身份的余弦相似度高低调节注意力头去相关正则，对困难样本施加更强的头解耦，并发现只在最后几层解耦优于全网正则，从而在不改动结构、不增加推理开销的前提下提升人脸识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按样本难度调节注意力头解耦强度、且仅作用于末层」的训练思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中多头/多步 latent 状态是否冗余互补及困难样本的监督分配，但论文面向人脸识别判别嵌入，与推理期 latent 生成无直接联系。
